arxiv-2208-06814.creator: Zhenguo Liang, Zhiyan Zhao, Qi Zhou
arxiv-2208-06814.description: Abstract . For 1D quantum harmonic oscillator perturbed by a time quasi-periodic quadratic form of ( x , − i ∂ x ) (x,-{\rm i}\partial_{x}) , we show its almost reducibility. The growth of Sobolev norms of solution is described based on the scheme of almost reducibility.

arxiv-2301-12543.title: Properties of covariant Lyapunov vectors as continuous vector fields
arxiv-2301-12543.creator: Massimo Marino a and Doriano Brogioli b
arxiv-2301-12543.description: Abstract We introduce the concept of “covariant Lyapunov field”, which assigns all the components of covariant Lyapunov vectors at almost all points of the phase space of a dynamical system. We focus on the case in which these fields are overall continuous and also differentiable along individual trajectories.

arxiv-2404-10208.title: Forecasting Tech Sector Market Downturns based on Macroeconomic Indicators
arxiv-2404-10208.creator: Morteza Maleki
arxiv-2404-10208.description: Abstract Predicting stock price movements is a pivotal element of investment strategy, providing insights into potential trends and market volatility. This study specifically examines the predictive capacity of historical stock prices and technical indicators within the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) Information Technology Sector, focusing on companies established before 1980.

arxiv-2408-09303.title: Primordial black hole numbers: standard formulas and charts
arxiv-2408-09303.creator: Eemeli Tomberg
arxiv-2408-09303.description: Abstract This brief note presents standard computations of primordial black hole mass M M given perturbations of scale k k , and their late-time abundance Ω PBH \Omega_{\text{PBH}} given their initial density fraction β \beta . I recap the assumptions made in these computations and present formulas and reference charts useful for a working cosmologist.

arxiv-2410-19442.creator: Kam Hung TONG
arxiv-2410-19442.description: Abstract It is a classical result that the set K \ G / B K\backslash G/B is finite, where G G is a reductive algebraic group over an algebraically closed field with characteristic not equal to two, B B is a Borel subgroup of G G , and K = G θ K=G^{\theta} is the fixed point subgroup of an

arxiv-2503-20119.title: Approximating Opaque Top-k Queries Journal: PACMMOD Volume: 3 3 (SIGMOD) 129 6 DOI: 10.1145/3725266 CCS: Information systems Database query processing
arxiv-2503-20119.creator: Jiwon Chang, Fatemeh Nargesian
arxiv-2503-20119.description: Abstract . Combining query answering and data science workloads has become prevalent. An important class of such workloads is top-k queries with a scoring function implemented as an opaque UDF—a black box whose internal structure and scores on the search domain are unavailable. Some typical examples include costly calls to fuzzy classification and regression models.

arxiv-2512-06324.title: Subsampling Confidence Bound for Persistent Diagram via Time-delay Embedding
arxiv-2512-06324.creator: Donghyun Park, Junhyun An, Taehyoung Kim, Jisu Kim
arxiv-2512-06324.description: Abstract Time-delay embedding is a fundamental technique in Topological Data Analysis (TDA) for reconstructing the phase space dynamics of time-series data. While persistent homology effectively identifies topological features, such as cycles associated with periodicity, a rigorous statistical framework for quantifying the uncertainty of these features has been lacking in this context.

arxiv-2602-00825.title: Harmful Overfitting in Sobolev Spaces
arxiv-2602-00825.creator: Kedar Karhadkar, Alexander Sietsema, Deanna Needell, Guido Montufar

arxiv-2602-03374.title: How do people watch AI-generated videos of physical scenes?
arxiv-2602-03374.creator: Danqing Shi, Lan Jiang, Katherine M. Collins, Shangzhe Wu, Ayush Tewari, Miri Zilka, University of Cambridge, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
arxiv-2602-03374.description: Abstract The growing prevalence of realistic AI-generated videos on media platforms increasingly blurs the line between fact and fiction, eroding public trust. Understanding how people watch AI-generated videos offers a human-centered perspective for improving AI detection and guiding advancements in video generation. However, existing studies have not investigated human gaze behavior in response to AI-generated videos of physical scenes.

arxiv-2602-13195.title: Conversational Image Segmentation: Grounding Abstract Concepts with Scalable Supervision
arxiv-2602-13195.creator: Aadarsh Sahoo, Georgia Gkioxari
arxiv-2602-13195.description: Abstract Conversational image segmentation grounds abstract, intent-driven concepts into pixel-accurate masks. Prior work on referring image grounding focuses on categorical and spatial queries ( e.g. , “left-most apple”) and overlooks functional and physical reasoning ( e.g. , “where can I safely store the knife?”).

arxiv-2602-14301.title: DeepFusion: Accelerating MoE Training via Federated Knowledge Distillation from Heterogeneous Edge Devices
arxiv-2602-14301.creator: Songyuan Li, Jia Hu, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem, Geyong Min, Haojun Huang, Jiwei Huang
arxiv-2602-14301.description: Abstract Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based large language models (LLMs) such as Qwen-MoE and DeepSeek-MoE are transforming generative AI in natural language processing. However, these models require vast and diverse training data. Federated learning (FL) addresses this challenge by leveraging private data from heterogeneous edge devices for privacy-preserving MoE training.

pmc-11563792.title: Genome-wide linkage mapping of Fusarium crown rot in common wheat (Triticum aestivum L.)
pmc-11563792.creator: Faji Li, Can Guo, Qi Zhao, Weie Wen, Shengnan Zhai, Xinyou Cao, Cheng Liu, Dungong Cheng, Jun Guo, Yan Zi, Aifeng Liu, Jianmin Song, Jianjun Liu, Jindong Liu, Haosheng Li
pmc-11563792.description: IntroductionFusarium crown rot (FCR) is a severe soil-borne disease that affects wheat globally and leads to significant yield reductions. Identifying the loci associated with resistance to FCR and developing corresponding markers are essential for the breeding of resistant wheat varieties.

pmc-12420418.title: Sexual habits and chemsex use in a monographic consultation for sexually transmitted infections (STI)
pmc-12420418.creator: C Herranz Serfaty, S Moreno Guillen, M Sánchez, A Muñoz San José, M E Sánchez-Escalonilla Relea, M Viana Perez, Á Esquembre García
pmc-12420418.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionThe use of recreational drugs for sexual intercourse (chemsex) is a widespread practice in certain subgroups of the population in recent years. pmc-12445572.title: A traditional Cameroonian spice, Syzygium guineense curtails leukemia tumor growth through G2-M cell cycle arrest and predicted NLRP3 inflammasome pathway

pmc-12445572.description: BackgroundS. guineense DC. var. macrocarpum (Engl.) F. White. plant has been a traditional Cameroonian spice used as medicine to treat several health conditions such as liver cirrhosis, vaginal infections, and cancer.ObjectiveThis study aims to investigate the anti-cancer effects of Syzygium guineense plant parts on leukemia preclinical models.Material and methodsCrude extracts and fractions of S.

pmc-12481914.title: The effectiveness of mobilization in treating patients with temporomandibular disorders: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12481914.creator: Prangtip Potewiratnanond, Sudaporn Pummoung, Chidsanu Changsiripun
pmc-12481914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effectiveness of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) mobilization in individuals with temporomandibular disorders (TMDs), using data from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and before-after studies without control groups. Human studies assessing outcomes, including muscle activity, pain intensity, oral and cervical range of motion, and self-reported measures before and after mobilization, and comparing these results with those of individuals who received other conventional TMD treatments, were considered.

pmc-12607198.title: Effect of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids on the treatment of schizophrenia: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12607198.creator: Chia-Yu Lin, Jen-Ai Lee, Tzu-Rong Peng, Pei-Yun Tsai, Pin-Hao Huang, Ming-Chia Lee, Shih Ming Chen
pmc-12607198.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSchizophrenia is a chronic disorder, and treatment options for its negative and cognitive symptoms are limited. Omega-3 fatty acids have potential neuroprotective effects, but evidence of their efficacy in schizophrenia and ultra-high risk group is inconsistent. This study aimed to provide an updated meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials evaluating the effectiveness of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation in patients with schizophrenia and ultra-high risk group.MethodsA PRISMA-guided meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials comparing omega-3 fatty acids with placebo in schizophrenia was conducted.

pmc-12654802.title: Electrical Characterization and Simulation of GaN-on-Si Pseudo-Vertical MOSFETs with Frequency-Dependent Gate C–V Investigation
pmc-12654802.creator: Valentin Ackermann, Mohammed El Amrani, Blend Mohamad, Riadh Ben Abbes, Matthew Charles, Sebastien Cavalaglio, Manuel Manrique, Julien Buckley, Bassem Salem
pmc-12654802.description: This work presents a comprehensive study of GaN-on-Si pseudo-vertical MOSFETs focusing on single-trench and multi-trench designs. Thanks to a gate-first process flow based on an Al2O3/TiN MOS stack, both fabricated devices exhibit promising transistor behavior, with steady normally OFF operation, very low gate leakage current, and good switching performance.

pmc-12790395.title: A classical variant of ectodermal dysplasia: a case report
pmc-12790395.creator: Switi Jawade, Pratibha Wankhede, Ranjana Sharma, Pratiksha Munjewar, Vidhya More
pmc-12790395.description: Ectodermal dysplasias are characterized by abnormalities in two or more ectodermal structures, including hair, sweat glands, nails, etc. and are a rare group of congenital disorders. It is characterized by the triad of three conditions, namely hypohidrosis, hypotrichosis, and hypodontia.

pmc-13191962.title: Association of TP53 polymorphic variants rs1042522 and rs1642785 with susceptibility and prognosis of acute lymphoblastic leukemia in a Brazilian Amazon population
pmc-13191962.creator: Glenda Menezes Nogueira, Luca Gabriel Marques Gonçalves, Thaís Lohana Pereira-Ribeiro, Larissa Silva Santos, Fábio Magalhães-Gama, Nilberto Dias Araújo, Adriana Malheiro, Andréa Monteiro Tarragô, Fabíola Silva Alves-Hanna, Allyson Guimarães Costa
pmc-13191962.description: BackgroundTumor suppressor genes play a central role in cancer development, and inherited genetic variation may influence both disease susceptibility and clinical outcomes. This study aimed to investigate the frequency and prognostic relevance of TP53 polymorphic variants in patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) from an admixed population in the Brazilian Amazon.

pmc-13211408.title: Evaluating the Ecotoxicological Effects of Microplastics on Terrestrial Passerines: Insights from Eurasian Tree Sparrows
pmc-13211408.creator: Mo Li, Jun Wang, Weiyue Meng, Liqiang Du, Dongming Li, Yanfeng Sun
pmc-13211408.description: Microplastic (MP) pollution poses a threat to wild animals, but its toxicological impact on terrestrial passerines remains unclear. To address this gap, we conducted the first systematic study investigating how microplastic particle size and dosage jointly influence gut microbiota and multi-system physiological functions in a small terrestrial bird.

pmc-13235635.title: Chip-Scale Aligned Chiral Carbon Nanotubes Exhibiting Giant Second Harmonic Generation
pmc-13235635.creator: Rui Xu, Jacques Doumani, Viktor Labuntsov, Nina Hong, Anna-Christina Samaha, Weiran Tu, Fuyang Tay, Elizabeth Blackert, Jiaming Luo, Mario El Tahchi, Weilu Gao, Jun Lou, Yohei Yomogida, Kazuhiro Yanagi, Riichiro Saito, Vasili Perebeinos, Andrey Baydin, Junichiro Kono, Hanyu Zhu
pmc-13235635.description: Chiral carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are direct-gap semiconductors with optical properties governed by one-dimensional excitons with enormous oscillator strengths. Each species of chiral CNTs has an enantiomeric pair of left- and right-handed CNTs with nearly identical properties, but enantiomer-dependent phenomena can emerge, especially in nonlinear optical processes.

pmc-13392051.title: Deep learning-based neonatal outcome prediction: an LSTM autoencoder framework for pattern analysis and risk assessment
pmc-13392051.creator: Safiya Parvin A, Saleena B
pmc-13392051.description: The phenomenon of neonatal mortality is a significant issue in health care, which necessitates the use of advanced analytical tools for early risk prediction. This work utilized the Medical Information Mart (MIMIC) Pediatric Intensive Care (PIC) database to develop a framework for identifying key biomarkers associated with mortality risk.

pmc-13486356.title: Isolated fracture of the anterior wall of the acetabulum: A rare fracture, even rarer in the skeletally immature patient. Report of two cases and literature review
pmc-13486356.creator: Vincenzo Giordano, Anderson Freitas, Nicolle Barreto, Jhordana Esteves dos Santos, Carolina Braga dos Santos Azevedo, Cynthia Storino Pavan
pmc-13486356.description: BackgroundIsolated anterior wall acetabular fracture (AWAF) is a rare injury in adults and even rarer among the skeletally immature population.Case presentationWe present the cases of two skeletally immature patients (a 13-year-old boy [case #1] and a 10-year-old boy [case #2]) with displaced isolated AWAF, surgically treated using the Smith-Petersen approach with osteotomy of the anterior superior iliac spine.
